results.title: Mobile Game Developer
results.description:
Who We Are

At YallaPlay , We are a rapidly growing startup mobile gaming studio on a mission to bring people together through play, we create exciting mobile games that bring joy to millions of players worldwide. Founded in Austin, Texas, we’ve since expanded to Brazil and the UAE, growing our diverse and talented team of creators. We pride ourselves on a fun and collaborative work environment, with a remote-friendly culture and a dedication to producing high-quality, engaging games. Our current titles, including “Spades Masters” (iOS/Android), have been enjoyed by millions of players globally.

Our passion lies in reinventing card games infusing them with fresh mechanics, beautiful design, and social features that spark connection and excitement. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for creative, driven individuals who are excited to help shape the future of multiplayer mobile gaming in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Join us and be part of building something big from the ground up.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Unity Developer to help build high-quality mobile games faster and smarter. Reporting to the Lead Unity Developer, you'll use modern AI development tools alongside your technical expertise to implement game features, prototype ideas rapidly, solve complex engineering problems, and continuously improve development velocity.

This role spans the entire game development lifecycle, from rapid prototyping to live operations. Success requires strong Unity fundamentals, excellent engineering judgment, and the ability to use AI as a force multiplier while maintaining high standards for code quality, performance, and player experience.

This position is remote and from Brazil.

What You’ll Be Doing

Develop and implement mobile games in Unity for iOS and Android.

Use AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, documentation, testing, and prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards.

Collaborate with designers, producers, artists, backend engineers, and QA to deliver polished player experiences.

Write clean, scalable, maintainable C# code and validate AI-generated code before production use.

Rapidly prototype gameplay mechanics and iterate based on team feedback.

Optimize performance across a wide range of mobile devices using Unity profiling tools.

Debug complex gameplay, networking, memory, and platform-specific issues.

Implement gameplay systems, UI, animations, VFX, audio, and live operations features.

Contribute to CI/CD, build automation, and deployment pipelines.

Review code, improve engineering standards, and contribute to reusable systems and internal tools.

Continuously evaluate new AI tools and workflows that improve team productivity.

Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning and daily standups.

What We’re Looking For

What you need to have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Interactive Media, or equivalent experience.

5+ years developing mobile games with Unity.

At least 2 shipped mobile game titles.

Excellent C# programming skills.

Strong understanding of Unity architecture, UI Toolkit/uGUI, prefabs, asset management, animation, audio, and scene management.

Experience building both 2D and 3D mobile games.

Experience optimizing CPU, GPU, memory, and battery performance.

Experience with REST APIs, WebSockets, or multiplayer networking.

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Experience working in Agile teams.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

AI-First Development

We expect our engineers to use AI as part of their daily workflow. You should:

Be comfortable using AI coding assistants (such as Unity AI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar).

Know how to write effective prompts for technical tasks.

Critically review, validate, test, and improve AI-generated code rather than accepting it blindly.

Use AI to accelerate debugging, documentation, testing, refactoring, and code generation.

Continuously experiment with new AI workflows that improve development speed without compromising quality.

Understand the limitations, risks, and security considerations of AI-assisted software development.

Why YallaPlay

What You Get

Real Impact – You’ll work on meaningful projects that reach a global audience.

Collaborative Culture – Small team, big ambition. We keep things fun, respectful, and feedback-driven.

Benefits & Perks

Competitive salary

Remote-first and flexible schedule- Digital nomad friendly

Generous paid time off

Paid birthdays off

Growth opportunities and access to learning resources

A team that actually loves games—and each other

Next Steps

Ready to join the team? We’d love to hear from you!

Apply

Share sample code and projects (GitHub)

We review every application carefully and will be in touch if there’s a fit. Good luck!

results.title: ServiceNow Developer, AI & Intelligent Automation
results.description:
As a key member of the Enterprise IT Team, the ServiceNow Developer, AI & Intelligent Automation designs, develops, tests, implements, and maintains solutions on the ServiceNow platform for Empyrean. This role enhances Empyrean’s IT Service Management and business processes through platform development, workflow automation, integrations, and AI-enabled capabilities. This role independently delivers assigned development, automation, integration, and AI-enabled solutions within established technical and governance standards, and helps determine whether AI, intelligent automation, traditional workflow automation, or standard ServiceNow configuration best fits a given business need. The role requires demonstrated AI and intelligent automation experience gained outside of ServiceNow, applied within the ServiceNow platform.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Collaborates with cross-functional teams to design, configure, troubleshoot, and implement ServiceNow applications and solutions.

Designs, builds, tests, implements, documents, and supports scalable ServiceNow solutions, including service catalog offerings, workflows, self-service capabilities, and Flow Designer automations, using established platform standards.

Integrates ServiceNow with enterprise systems and manages the associated data exchange.

Develops and maintains business rules, assignment and approval rules, client scripts, flows, and other platform components.

Applies working knowledge of AI and intelligent automation concepts, including generative AI, predictive models, and automation/RPA approaches, to translate business and operational requirements into practical ServiceNow solutions.

Contributes to decisions on whether AI, automation, or standard ServiceNow configuration best addresses a given business need.

Configures, integrates, tests, implements, and supports approved ServiceNow AI and intelligent automation capabilities, applying required data quality, security, privacy, access control, human oversight, testing, and monitoring standards.

Identifies automation and AI-enabled improvement opportunities and provides technical input on feasibility, dependencies, risks, and implementation needs, drawing on broader AI and automation knowledge beyond ServiceNow-specific tools.

Contributes to proofs of concept and pilots for new AI and automation capabilities.

Provides technical input to project planning, estimation, and delivery; organizes work through initiatives, epics, stories, and tasks; and communicates progress, dependencies, and risks.

Participates in code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continual improvement of ServiceNow development practices; escalates complex architectural decisions or risks to Senior Developers as needed.

Participates in ServiceNow upgrades, including impact analysis, testing, and validation, and reviews release dependencies affecting assigned applications and automations.

Organizes and manages assigned development and support responsibilities independently, escalating competing priorities or delivery risks when appropriate.

Monitors, troubleshoots, and improves implemented ServiceNow and AI-enabled capabilities after launch.

Participate in an on-call rotation and provide after-hours support as required, including responding to production incidents, service disruptions, and other time-sensitive operational issues.

Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Analytical, problem-solving mindset within the ServiceNow ecosystem.

Proficiency in ServiceNow development and JavaScript, with the ability to design and implement solutions across applications, modules, workflows, integrations, and data sources.

Working knowledge of AI and intelligent automation concepts and technologies, such as generative AI, predictive and machine learning models, and automation/RPA, gained independent of any single platform and sufficient to evaluate practical benefits, limitations, use cases, and risks.

Ability to apply AI and intelligent automation judgment within the ServiceNow ecosystem, including data quality, security, privacy, access control, human oversight, testing, and monitoring considerations.

Ability to translate business and operational requirements into technical designs and implementation tasks.

Ability to identify technical risks, recommend solutions, and escalate complex decisions or exceptions when appropriate.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical and AI-related concepts to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Proactive approach to problem identification, issue resolution, and prevention; gives and receives constructive feedback effectively.

Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and workloads independently within established technical and organizational standards.

Ability to contribute to the scope and design of initiatives, epics, stories, and tasks, and to perform root cause analysis on support tickets and incidents.

Demonstrates technical ownership of assigned work and contributes to design decisions and discussions within established standards.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND/OR EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required. Equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field will be considered, as will any equivalent combination of education, experience, certifications, and training.

Three to five years of ServiceNow development experience, or an equivalent combination of ServiceNow and closely related enterprise platform-development experience.

Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting, configuration, application development, workflow automation, and integrations.

Working knowledge of ITSM, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, integrations, and ServiceNow platform support. Experience with additional ServiceNow modules is preferred.

Demonstrated experience independently delivering ServiceNow development work and partnering with technical and business stakeholders on automation or AI-enabled use cases.

Demonstrated, hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, generative AI, or intelligent automation/RPA technologies gained in any enterprise setting, not limited to ServiceNow. This experience is required in addition to, and independent of, ServiceNow platform experience.

Hands-on experience delivering at least one AI or intelligent automation capability on the ServiceNow platform is also required, such as Now Assist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, AI agents, predictive intelligence, generative AI integrations, or AI-enabled workflows. Qualifying experience includes configuration, integration, testing, implementation, or contribution to a pilot, proof of concept, or production solution; experience with every capability is not required.

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer preferred, though equivalent ServiceNow development experience may qualify. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and additional platform, automation, or AI-related certifications are valued.

Experience with benefit program administration or Health and Welfare processes is a plus.

Disclaimer: This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the job. Management reserves the right to modify or reassign job duties as business needs evolve.
Empyrean is an Equal Opportunity Employer: including disability and protected veteran status

results.title: E-Learning Instructional Designer - People Development
results.description:
What are we building?
Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.
Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?
What's the position?
As the People Development Experience Designer , you will play a pivotal role in executing the People Development Strategic Playbook across the business. This position involves a contribution to the creative design of engaging learning for blended (primarily digital), multi-format support for the learner experience and employee lifecycle. This will include leveraging adult learning and instructional design best practice and will support the People Development Roadmaps to enhance Team Member capability around behavior, skills, knowledge, and performance. You will collaborate with key stakeholders to identify development needs, develop effective online solutions, help create a culture of continuous learning and development. In addition, you will ensure all courses that you design are critically reviewed and adapted considering feedback as part of the Performance Development evaluation processes and report of ROI.
Key Responsibilities
Business Partnering:
Work with and consult subject matter experts (SMEs) to identify learning needs and objectives, gather accurate design requirements and facilitate an effective development process.

Collaborate with SMEs and cross-functional business partners to ensure learning meets the objectives for the business/department and individual.

Partner with SMEs to maintain/revise internal content and curriculum.

Contribute to the development and communication of the People Development Strategic Playbook and Roadmaps.

Partner with People Development team members on projects and programs that improve the overall learning experience.

Manage and complete projects within a specified timeline while prioritizing and working on multiple projects simultaneously.

Needs Assessment and Analysis:
Conduct regular needs assessments to identify skill gaps and recommend People Development Roadmap priorities across the business.

Establish learning metrics to evaluate and analyse the impact and return on investment of People Development initiatives on individual, departmental and organizational performance.

Utilize analytics and feedback from team member performance and engagement surveys to help drive strategic decisions that support both individual, departmental and business growth.

Recommend adjustments to ensure desired outcomes are met and products within the People Development portfolio are continuously evolving to ensure effective initiatives.

Learning Program Management:

Develop project plans for design / development of identified solutions (e.g., in-scope / out of scope elements, timeframes, resources, roles / responsibilities, priorities, cost estimates, feasibility analyses, risks / assumptions).

Design and develop dynamic instructional content and simulations to create interactive, engaging, impactful courses and appropriate for the business need and audience.

Creatively market to all team members to maximize engagement (flyers, email communications etc) with the People Development Academy portfolio.

Ensure programs are aligned with industry best practices and tailored to meet the specific needs of the business.

Contribute to and maintain the People Development Academy portfolio training/course catalog.

Adopting cohesive style guide and ensure a consistent design language is applied to the PD portfolio.

Write and edit audio voice-over scripts for e-learning, when needed.

Liaise with vendors, negotiate best term agreements and undertake internal vendor registration.

Learning Technology Integration:

Stay abreast of emerging learning technologies and tools to enhance the delivery and accessibility of the People Development portfolio.

Monitor subscriptions for learning platforms across the business and provide data to inform decision-making for utilization purposes.

Work with Operations L&D ensure all PD portfolio is uploaded against the roadmap and ensure appropriate reporting is undertaken.

Create assessments and evaluations to measure the effectiveness of learning interventions using key performance metrics.

Requirements
What are we looking for?
We are looking for an individual who has excellent written and verbal communication skills with a commanding presence. The role is best suited for a candidate who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment with a passion for sports, gaming and helping others.
The ideal candidate will have:

5+ years of experience in L&D, HR, Talent Management or similar roles, ideally within technology, creative industries or online gaming sectors.

Bachelor’s degree in Learning and Development, Human Resources or professional equivalent such as Certified Professional in Learning and Performance (CPLP), Certified Learning and Development Professional (CLDP) or Certified Professional in Training Management (CPTM).

2+ years’ experience developing corporate e-Learning in tools such as Articulate 360, Adobe, Synthesia and PowerPoint.

A curious mindset and a strong desire to learn and develop with evidence of Continuous Professional Development.

Strong understanding of andragogy principles, instructional design, and learning technologies.

Contemporary knowledge of e-learning practices and strategies, including micro and bitesize learning.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, facilitation, stakeholder management to effectively communicate with all levels within the business and outside vendors.

Experience of implementing and using an LMS and online learning technology.

Proficiency in analyzing data and use insights for decision-making and recommendations to business leaders and the People Leadership Team.

Strategic thinker with the ability to align learning initiatives with organizational goals.

Familiarity with industry trends and best practices in learning and development.

Experience in the Gaming Industry a distinct advantage
